articles.title: Cardano hands core development to outside teams in decentralization push
articles.snippet: Input Output will transfer control of the Haskell node, Plutus, Hydra and other components as founder Charles Hoskinson says the network must change and start growing again.

articles.title: Bitcoin faces fresh headwinds as China’s Kimi beats Claude, GPT in coding benchmark
articles.snippet: Moonshot's Kimi K3 took the top spot in frontend coding away from Claude and OpenAI, and it's free. Semiconductor stocks fell, and crypto fell with them.

articles.title: Airbnb CEO says X account was hacked, attacker posted AI-slop on tokenization
articles.snippet: Brian Chesky regained control of his account and told any new crypto followers he would be a "disappointing follow".

articles.title: Ether falls twice as hard as bitcoin and HYPE drops 10% as the chip trade unwinds
articles.snippet: Japan's Nikkei had its worst day since March. Ether is still the only major holding a gain on the week, barely.

articles.title: DOG Mode vs. BIP-110: Inside the Bitcoin client built to bypass data restrictions
articles.snippet: While BIP 110 wants to restrict data through a consensus change and has almost no miner support, a new DOG Mode client wants the opposite and requires no vote at all.
